description:

**Location:** Houston, TX, USA
  

**Job Reference \#:** 33169

Plenitude Renewables US Inc. is a leading renewable energy company and part of Plenitude, Eni's integrated energy transition business. Based in Houston, Texas, the company develops, owns, and operates utility\-scale renewable energy and energy storage assets across the United States, with a focus on solar, wind, and battery storage projects. Through innovation, strategic partnerships, and a commitment to sustainability, Plenitude Renewables US contributes to the growth of clean energy infrastructure while supporting the transition to a lower\-carbon energy future. title: Power Protection and Automation Engineering Development Program (June Cohort)
description:
**Transform the everyday with us!**  

Take your first step into an exciting future career with **Siemens**, a global leader in power protection and automation. Join our **Engineering Development Program** and unlock your potential in shaping a sustainable world. **We are seeking qualified candidates for our Power Protection and Automation Engineering Development Program (PA EDP) beginning June 7th, 2027\. The **Power Protection and Automation Engineering Development Program** places you on the **Siemens Smart Infrastructure Electrification \& Automation** team in a one\-year development program focused on power protection and automation in electrical substations, with a structured pathway across two tracks: Protection and Automation.  

Throughout the program, you’ll contribute to projects that support the modernization of critical power infrastructure, including utility substations, digital substations, data centers, semiconductor and advanced manufacturing campuses, renewable energy interconnections, battery energy storage systems, and solar\-integrated microgrids. **You’ll make an impact by:*** Completing two six\-month technical rotations, one on Protection and one on Automation, including approximately seven weeks of technical and safety training in Wendell, NC, integrated with six hands\-on field rotations (three in each area). * Designing and implementing power protection and automation solutions.

title: Director, Transmission Planning
description:
**About Exus Renewables North America**


Exus Renewables North America is a leading independent developer and operator of utility\-scale renewable energy projects, dedicated to advancing clean energy solutions across the United States. With offices in Pittsburgh, New York, and Albuquerque, and over 100 employees in the US, Exus NA focuses on developing, repowering, and managing renewable energy assets, contributing to the nation's decarbonization efforts and driving sustainable growth in the U.S. renewable energy sector.

  

The **Director of Transmission Planning** will support Exus’ transmission and interconnection activities across all applicable interconnection regions and RTOs/ISOs. This role is responsible for developing and executing portfolio\-level interconnection strategies, interpreting and anticipating changes to RTO/ISO tariffs and modeling approaches, and advocating internal and external mitigation strategies to manage interconnection risk, cost exposure, and schedule impacts.

 **Essential Responsibilities:**

* Lead interconnection activities for new and existing generation projects, including oversight of detailed electrical modeling, power system analyses, and strategic assessments of transmission constraints, upgrade requirements, and interconnection risk.
* Manage the full interconnection lifecycle across multiple markets to secure Interconnection Agreements (IAs/GIAs), from application submission through study phases, negotiation, and execution, while ensuring alignment with regulatory milestones, portfolio sequencing, and downstream construction and operations requirements.
* Evaluate and compare interconnection alternatives at both the project and portfolio level to optimize outcomes across cost, schedule, offtake priorities, transmission risk, and capital efficiency in close collaboration with other departments.
* Serve as the primary point of contact with RTOs/ISOs and interconnected transmission owners for GIA/IA execution, implementation

title: Data Center Chief Engineer
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.
  

  

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third\-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support AWS.
  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
